stages.detail: Play the opening: Gone Fishing and the rest of Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen and follow her onto the balcony to meditate when she offers. That moment is the only missable trophy content in the game — once Chapter 1 ends it never comes back. Start two habits now that pay off all run long: scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app (unlocked in Chapter 1) and study new animals through the binoculars. Save manually at the chapter's end.
stages.missable_note: Positive Mental Attitude: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house, after Down to Earth. Do it before Chapter 1 ends — it cannot be recovered later.
stages.name: Chapter 1 — and the one thing you can lose

stages.detail: Play the story to the final mission. Every chapter and named-mission trophy is automatic and cannot be missed: Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. Take optional missions as they appear (you will want 100 of them later anyway), keep scanning vehicles and studying animals as you travel, and rotate manual saves at each chapter break. Avoid locking yourself into the permanent Irredeemable criminal profile.
stages.name: Chapters 2 to 5 — finish the story
stages.time: about 60–80 hours for the whole story

stages.detail: After the credits you return to free-roam and the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It asks for far less than everything — roughly 60% of the game. Five categories must be complete: robberies, underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting range challenges at gold, all 14 Top Fun drone races won, and Bret's quests. Add 70 of the 80 challenges (skip the ten hardest), 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied and 100 optional missions, most of which Stage 2 already banked.
stages.name: Open the 100% Completion checklist
stages.time: the long middle — guides budget about 100 hours

stages.detail: Sweep up the counted collectibles: meditate at all 18 spots (the Chapter 1 one is already done if you followed Stage 1), complete collectible card sets — 3 for the trophy, 15 for the checklist — WAiNK at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles on the way to 200 scans, complete 250 stunts (300 for the checklist; under-bridge flights are the fastest), and unfog all 52 areas of Leonida.
stages.name: Collectibles and the map

stages.detail: Finish 8 stranger mission strands, including the final missions for Andy (Lucia's strand), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason's strand), and complete Bret's hunting quests. None of these people disappear for good: anyone unavailable mid-story is back in free-roam, so nothing here can be locked out.
stages.name: Strangers, freaks and character questlines

stages.detail: Clear the remaining board: rob 5 bank vaults (8 for the checklist) and an armored truck, hit an illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs, rob a jewelry store unseen, launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles to Scooter Bros. Then the one-offs: all 9 activity types, Cal's fishing challenge, an arcade game, 20 race wins, the partner wanted-level escapes, 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus, the unscheduled VCIA departure, the Rhino encounter, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom exit, the bowling alley, both partners' strength, 500 choices, the second-chance moment, the strange sighting and the melee drive-by.
stages.name: Crime, cash and one-off moments
stages.time: cleanup, as the map opens up

stages.detail: When the last of the other 54 trophies is earned, Vice Got a Price! unlocks by itself. If the counter says 54 of 55 and nothing has popped, the usual suspects are a meditation spot, a card set or a challenge count — the tracker view of this guide shows exactly which one is still open.
stages.name: The platinum

summary: One playthrough, roughly 200 hours, no difficulty settings and no online trophies. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off from the first mission to the last. There is no mission replay: keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. Almost everything can be finished in free-roam after the story — the single exception is flagged in Stage 1.
title: Road to the Platinum — Leonida in seven stages
